findings.current: Do you know what it’s like to have the top of your head stepped on after using the Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms?
findings.defect: The wording makes the head-stomping merely subsequent to using the technique, losing the source’s emphasis that it happened despite him performing it.
findings.rationale: 펼치고도 marks a concessive contrast: even after performing the Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms, he had the top of his head stepped on.
findings.replacement: Do you know what it’s like to have the top of your head stepped on even after using the Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms?

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but one line reverses who takes the credit, and another loses the source’s concessive emphasis.
